_doc: Generated by tools/icons/export_skills.gd from the live class kits. Do not hand-edit.

classes.famous: 黄少天 Huang Shaotian / 夜雨声烦 Troubling Rain / 冰雨 Ice Rain

skills.desc: 光剑快斩 Quick lightsaber slash.
Lv1 上挑浮空 Rising slash that launches the target.
三次冲刺斩，可变向 Three dashing slashes; re-aims between dashes.
圆弧拔刀斩并放出剑气 Arc draw-slash that releases a piercing sword aura.
空中下劈将目标砸地 Aerial down-slash that slams the target to the ground.
前冲连续突刺后击退 Forward dash into rapid stabs, ending in a knockback.
格挡正面物理攻击，大幅减伤 Blocks frontal physical attacks (-75% damage).
Lv70 大招：无形剑影连斩，终结强力击飞 Phantom flurry of slashes ending in a huge blow-away.
回手斩 Backhand slash.
突刺收尾 Finishing thrust that pushes back.

passives.desc: 光剑攻速提升；连击数≥5时攻速再+15% Lightsaber attack speed up; +15% attack speed at 5+ combo.

classes.famous: 孙哲平 Sun Zheping / 落花狼藉 Blossoming Chaos / Burial Blossoms

skills.desc: 大剑横斩 Heavy horizontal cleave.
Lv1 最高浮空的上挑斩，暴走时距离更长 Launcher with the highest knock-up; longer reach while Berserk.
跃起砸地冲击波，暴走时霸体 Leaping ground slam shockwave; super armor while Berserk.
X形十字斩，造成流血 X-shaped slash that inflicts Bleed.
割手放出血箭（消耗3%生命） Cuts own hand (3% HP) to fire a blood arrow.
血手将周围敌人拉近并抓取吸血 Crimson hand pulls nearby foes in, then grabs and drains one.
暴走12秒：攻击+20%、移速+15%，持续流失生命 Berserk 12 s: +20% attack, +15% speed, drains HP.
Lv70 大招：三重血浪爆发 Three expanding blood explosions around the Berserker.
下劈 Overhead chop.
回旋斩 Spinning cleave that knocks back.

passives.desc: 生命越低攻击越高（最高+40%） Attack rises as HP drops (up to +40%).
暴走时施放技能获得短暂霸体，伤害吸血5% While Berserk, skills grant brief super armor and 5% lifesteal.

classes.famous: 江波涛 Jiang Botao / 无浪 Empty Waves / Divine Chain

skills.desc: 短剑斩 Short-sword slash.
双手上挑震出地裂冲击波并浮空 Upward swing sending a ground-crack shockwave that launches.
挥出穿透波动剑气 Fires a piercing wave slash.
高伤害烈焰波动，击倒并灼烧 High-damage fire wave that knocks down and burns.
冰刃波动减速并有几率冰冻 Ice wave that slows with a chance to freeze.
咏唱电光波动阵，持续电击区域内敌人 Chanted lightning field that repeatedly shocks enemies inside.
剑气绕行后从目标背后折返（背击） Wave arcs around and returns from behind the target (back attack).
Lv75 大招：随机元素星云波动连发后爆裂 Volleys of random-element waves ending in a nebula burst.
回斩 Return slash.
斩出小型波动剑气 Slash that releases a small wave.

passives.desc: 每次施放波动剑技能叠加杀意，每层魔攻+4%（最多5层，6秒） Each wave skill adds a stack: +4% magic attack (max 5, 6 s).

classes.famous: 李轩 Li Xuan / 逢山鬼泣 Crying Devil / Ghost Killer Seal

skills.desc: 太刀斩 Tachi slash.
Lv1 鬼手上抓浮空 A ghostly claw rips upward and launches the target.
月牙斩将目标挑起 Crescent slash that knocks the target up.
满月回旋斩，强力击飞 Full-circle moon slash with a big blow-away.
布下冰阵：区域内敌人减速并有几率冰冻 Ice boundary: enemies inside are slowed and may freeze.
布下静寂之阵：区域内敌人被沉默 Silence boundary: enemies inside cannot use skills.
布下刀阵：区域内友方攻击+15% Sword boundary: allies inside gain +15% attack.
Lv70 大招：引爆所有鬼阵并在身边爆发鬼气 Detonates every active boundary plus a ghost burst around you.
回斩 Return slash.
双手重斩 Two-handed heavy cut.

passives.desc: 鬼阵为持续地面区域（最多3个）；站在自己的阵中伤害+10% Boundaries are persistent zones (max 3); +10% damage while inside your own.

classes.famous: 叶修 Ye Xiu / 一叶之秋 One Autumn Leaf / 却邪 Evil Annihilation

skills.desc: 战矛三段连击，第三段发射全部炫纹 Three-hit lance chain; the third hit fires all Chasers.
向前突刺并斜向上挑，将目标挑飞 Diagonal upward thrust that launches the target.
快速前刺，短暂眩晕，生成无属性炫纹 Fast high-priority stab that stuns briefly; adds a Neutral Chaser.
掌击将目标击飞，对空中目标伤害更高；生成火炫纹 Palm blast that blows the target away, stronger vs airborne; adds a Fire Chaser.
360度横扫，范围击倒，可破霸体；生成暗炫纹 360-degree sweep that knocks down and breaks super armor; adds a Shadow Chaser.
雷电长矛贯穿前方5米直线 Piercing lightning spear thrust along a 6 m line; adds a Light Chaser.
最强物理冲锋，长距离突进击倒 Strongest physical hit: long armored charge that knocks down; adds an Ice Chaser.
两段物理挑击后魔法爆炸（带抓取效果），并发射全部炫纹 Two launching sweeps, then an armor-breaking magic explosion; fires all Chasers. Long end lag.
横扫 Sweeping second hit.
重刺并发射全部炫纹 Heavy thrust that launches every stored Chaser.

passives.desc: 龙牙/落花掌/圆舞棍/怒龙穿心/豪龙破军生成元素炫纹（最多7个）环绕自身；普攻第三段与大招将其作为追踪魔法弹发射：无属性=攻击提升、冰=减速、火=灼烧、光=加速、暗=破防 Skills spawn elemental orbs (max 7) that orbit you; the basic finisher and the ultimate fire them as homing magic bolts: Neutral = attack up, Ice = slow, Fire = burn, Light = haste, Shadow = defense down.
连击数每3击提升一阶（最多7阶），每阶攻速+4%、移速+2%、物攻+3% Every 3 combo hits raise a stage (max 7): +4% attack speed, +2% move speed, +3% physical attack per stage.

classes.famous: 楚云秀 Chu Yunxiu / 风城烟雨 Windy Rain / 银武法杖 Ravaging Wind

skills.desc: 法杖三段魔法弹，可移动施放 Three-shot magic bolt chain, castable while moving.
在目标处生成元素力场，延迟后将敌人挑飞 Slow-cast element field that knocks enemies up.
快速直线闪电，贯穿路径上所有敌人 Fast straight lightning bolt that pierces every enemy in line.
目标处喷发3米火柱，挑飞并灼烧 Fire column at the target point that launches and burns.
4秒冰雹区域，每秒伤害并减速 4 s hail zone: damage every second and 50% slow.
画出持续5秒的冰线，触碰者被冻结 Draws a 5 s ice line; anyone touching it is frozen.
瞬移拉开距离 Instant blink away to reset spacing.
大范围天降雷击与地火灼烧 Huge area: three sky lightning strikes over a field of earthen fire.
第二发魔法弹 Second bolt.
较大的爆裂法弹，击退 Bigger bursting bolt with knockback.

passives.desc: 所有技能可边移动边施放（施法时移速70%） Every skill can be cast while moving (70% move speed while casting).

classes.famous: 王杰希 Wang Jiexi / 王不留行 Vaccaria / 灭绝星尘 Stardust Extermination

skills.desc: 扫把三段连击（飞行中亦可） Three-hit broom chain, usable in flight.
扫把上扫，将敌人轻微挑起 Upward broom sweep with a light knock-up.
远程追踪魔法飞弹；飞行中一次发射三枚 Long-range homing missile; fires a 3-missile volley while flying.
投掷熔岩瓶，爆炸后留下灼烧岩浆池 Thrown flask that explodes and leaves a burning lava pool.
撒出驱散粉：驱散增益，降低攻击、施法速度与移速8秒 Powder cone: strips buffs, lowers attack, cast speed and move speed for 8 s.
高优先级大范围暗影斗篷抓取，束缚后抛起 High-priority wide-area shadow grab: binds, then tosses the victim up.
投出修鲁鲁玩偶，持续嘲讽周围敌人 Throws the Shururu doll, which keeps taunting nearby enemies.
扫把风暴连续挑起敌人，最后将其砸向地面，并保持飞行 Storm of broom strikes that juggles, then slams targets down; ends in broom flight.
回扫 Backswing.
旋转扫击，击退周围敌人 Spinning sweep that knocks back everyone around.
嘲讽周围敌人 Taunts nearby enemies.

passives.desc: 空中再次跳跃骑上扫把飞行约4秒（可拍翼上升、滑翔下降，每次腾空最多4秒，无冷却，落地后可再次骑乘）；飞行中可使用所有技能，魔法飞弹变为三连发 Jump again in mid-air to ride the broom for ~4 s (flap up, glide down; up to 4 s per airtime, no cooldown - land to mount again). All skills work in flight and Magic Missile becomes a 3-missile volley.

classes.famous: 罗辑 Luo Ji / 昧光 Concealed Light

skills.desc: 法杖三段魔法弹 Three-shot staff bolt chain.
地面钻出藤刺，将目标挑飞 Thorns burst from the ground and launch the target.
召唤哥布林近战宠物（最多1只） Summons a melee Goblin pet (max 1).

skills.name_cn: 雷精灵 / 火精灵 / 冰精灵 / 暗精灵
skills.desc: 依次召唤雷/火/冰/暗精灵：眩晕、灼烧、减速、破防 Summons the next spirit in the cycle: Thunder (stagger), Fire (burn), Ice (slow), Dark (defense down).
在前方种下魔界之花炮台：毒液与藤蔓定身 Plants a static flower turret ahead: poison spit and rooting vines.
标记目标（防御-15%），所有宠物集火并加速，宠物攻击被标记目标额外造成20%伤害 Marks the target (-15% defense); every pet focuses it with a speed boost and pet hits on it deal +20%.
与最远的召唤物交换位置 Swaps places with your farthest summon.
引爆目标处魔阵并献祭所有元素精灵引发爆炸 Detonates a rune at the target and sacrifices every elemental spirit in explosions (full damage once per enemy).
第二发魔法弹 Second bolt.
较强的第三发法弹 Stronger third bolt with knockback.
棍棒击打 Club strike.
Thunder Spirit
Fire Spirit
Ice Spirit
Dark Spirit
喷吐毒液 Poison spit.
藤蔓定身 Vines root the target.

passives.desc: 召唤物攻击与防御+15% Your summons have +15% attack and defense.
离你超过16米的召唤物会被召回身边 Summons more than 16 m away are recalled to your side.

classes.famous: 周泽楷 Zhou Zekai / 一枪穿云 Cloud Piercer / 荒火 Wildfire + 碎霜 Shattered Frost

skills.desc: 右手左轮点射。空中开枪产生后坐力上浮。 Right-hand revolver shot; firing in the air pushes you up.
近身膝撞将敌人顶上浮空，衔接空中射击。 Close knee strike that pops the enemy into the air.
贴地滑铲突进，铲倒敌人。 Sliding rush that trips the enemy down.
踩住倒地的敌人连续射击，可追击倒地且令其无法受身。 Stomp-and-shoot a downed enemy; OTG, negates quick recovery.
双枪向前方乱射三轮扇形弹幕，可边移动边射击。 Three fan volleys of wild shots; can move while firing.
半圆回旋踢踢倒并击退身边敌人。 Semicircle kick that knocks nearby enemies down and away.
重新装填：立即恢复上一个使用过的技能（不含大招）。 Reload: the last skill you used (not the ultimate) is ready again.
架起巴雷特狙击枪，霸体蓄力后射出贯穿一条直线的狙击弹。 Super-armored sniper shot that pierces every enemy in a line.
左手左轮点射。 Left-hand revolver shot.
双枪齐射两发。 Both revolvers fire in quick succession.

passives.desc: 空中开枪的后坐力会把自己向上推，连续射击可长时间滞空。 Shots fired in the air push you upward; keep shooting to stay airborne.
攻击速度 +10%。 Attack speed +10%.
暴击率提高。 Higher critical chance.

classes.famous: 张佳乐 Zhang Jiale / 百花缭乱 Dazzling Hundred Blossoms / 猎寻 Hunting Seeker

skills.desc: 自动手枪两连发。 Two-round pistol burst.
特殊弹药：强力浮空弹，把敌人打上天。 Special bullet that knocks the enemy high into the air.
低冷却的撞击手雷，爆炸击退。 Low-cooldown impact grenade; the blast knocks enemies back.
特殊弹药：飞行较慢的子弹，命中造成强力眩晕。 Slow special bullet with a strong stun.
特殊弹药：减速并有几率冰冻目标。 Special bullet that slows and may freeze the target.
爆缩手雷，大范围强力击飞。 Grenade whose blast hurls enemies far away.
定时手雷落地后延时引爆，炸飞范围内敌人。 Grenade that detonates after a delay, blasting enemies upward.
一把把手雷同时抛出，炸开漫天花火（天女散花）。 Throws handfuls of grenades at once - a field of blossoming explosions.
自动手枪两连发。 Two-round pistol burst.
自动手枪三连发。 Three-round pistol spray.

passives.desc: 特殊弹药（浮空弹、僵直弹、冰弹）可储存 2 发，手雷可储存多枚。 Special bullets hold 2 charges; grenades hold several.
空中开枪产生少量上浮后坐力。 Shots fired in the air give a small upward recoil.

classes.famous: 苏沐橙 Su Mucheng / 沐雨橙风 Dancing Rain / 吞日 Devouring Sun

skills.desc: 手炮单发炮弹，落点小范围爆炸。 Single cannon shell with a small blast.
抡起手炮上挑，把贴身的敌人砸上浮空。 Upward cannon swing that launches a close enemy.
连射三发反坦克炮弹，每发造成短暂眩晕。 Three anti-tank shells, each with a brief stun.
发射贯穿直线的激光炮，强大后坐力把自己推后。 Piercing laser beam; the heavy recoil shoves you backward.
炮弹在目标上空分裂成 8 枚毒刺落下。 A shell that splits into 8 stingers raining on the target area.
手炮切换机枪模式倾泻弹流。 A stream of machine-gun bullets.
打响指锁定目标，发射追踪飞弹大范围爆炸。 Snap-lock a target and fire a homing missile with a wide blast.
召唤卫星射线：六道旋转光柱轰击目标区域。 Six rotating satellite beams bombard the target area.
装填后的重炮，击退更强。 Heavier follow-up shell with stronger knockback.

passives.desc: 伤害 +10%，远距离（12米以上）目标再 +10%。 Damage +10%, another +10% against targets 12 m or farther.
空中开炮会把自己向后上方推开，可用于空中位移。 Firing in the air kicks you back and up - use it to move in mid-air.

classes.famous: 肖时钦 Xiao Shiqin / 生灵灭 Life Extinguisher / Flashing Shadow

skills.desc: 步枪穿透射击，命中一条线上的敌人。 Penetrating rifle shot.
抛出跳雷，敌人踩中后弹起爆炸将其炸上浮空。 Pop-up mine: it springs up under the enemy and launches them.
放出追踪机器人，冲向敌人自爆。 Releases a robot that chases the enemy and self-destructs.
发射火箭推进的机械拳，击倒命中的敌人。 A rocket-propelled fist that knocks the enemy down.
布置磁场线圈陷阱，触发后大幅增加敌人负重。 Coil trap that weighs down whoever triggers it.
背上机械旋翼限时飞行，可在空中射击。 Rotor backpack: timed flight, keep shooting from the air.
放下空气压缩机，巨大气浪吹飞周围敌人。 A compressor blast that blows every nearby enemy away.
呼叫轰炸无人机，对目标区域螺旋空投炸弹。 Calls bomber drones and a spiral carpet of air-dropped bombs.
更重的穿透射击。 Heavier penetrating shot.
冲到敌人身边自爆。 Explodes next to the enemy.
向目标投下炸弹。 Drops a bomb on the target.

passives.desc: 机械装置（地雷、线圈、火箭拳、压缩机）及机器人、无人机命中会标记敌人 4 秒，步枪射击被标记的敌人额外造成 20% 伤害。 Gadget, robot and drone hits mark enemies for 4 s; rifle shots deal +20% to marked enemies.
空中开枪产生少量上浮后坐力，配合机械旋翼可长时间空中作战。 Shots in the air give a small upward recoil; combine with Rotor Wings.

classes.famous: 韩文清 Han Wenqing / 大漠孤烟 Desert Dust / 烈焰红拳 Flame Fists

skills.desc: 左右快拳起手 Quick opening jab.
Lv1 高踢将敌人踢上空中 Lv1 high kick that launches the enemy.
冲刺直拳突进并击退 Dashing punch that closes distance and knocks back.
跃起下踏，可踩倒地与空中敌人 Leaping stomp that hits airborne and downed foes.
8秒霸体并提升防御 8 s super armor plus 15% defense.
马步重拳，拳风波及前方 Horse-stance mega punch; its wind pressure hits along a line.
Lv30 格挡近战攻击并反击擒倒；未触发则出掌 Parries a melee hit and counters; palm strike if nothing comes.
Lv70 大招：猛虎般的连环拳，最后一击挑飞 Lv70 punch rush ending in a launching blow.
重直拳 Heavy cross punch.
旋身踢收尾，击退 Spinning kick finisher, knocks back.

passives.desc: 连续命中6次获得1.2秒霸体 Landing 6 hits in quick succession grants 1.2 s super armor.
格挡架势中受到近战攻击时免伤并反击 While in the parry stance, melee hits are negated and countered.

classes.famous: 方锐 Fang Rui / 海无量 Boundless Sea / Mirrored Moon

skills.desc: 裹气的掌击 Qi-wrapped palm strike.
Lv1 远程浮空：脚下逆流气柱，出手后不可打断 Lv1 longest-range launcher; a delayed qi geyser under the foe.
缓慢飞行的大气弹 A slow, heavy magic qi orb.
可操控的气龙：削弱敌人防御与速度，鼓舞身边队友 Steerable qi dragon: weakens foes, empowers nearby allies.
远距离隔空抓取，将敌人拉到面前 Long-range qi grab that drags the enemy in front of you.
气罩吸收伤害（18%生命，10秒） Qi barrier absorbing 18% max HP for 10 s.
Lv55 周身裹气向前贯穿冲锋 Lv55 qi-charged dash that blasts through enemies.
Lv70 大招：持续气爆伤害后巨大击飞 Lv70 sustained qi detonation, then a huge knockback.
回身第二掌 Second turning palm.
推出一团短程气劲 Pushes out a short qi burst.

passives.desc: 法力越高防御越高（最高+30%） Defense scales with current mana (up to +30%).

classes.famous: 李亦辉 Li Yihui / 沾衣乱飞 Flying Drops

skills.desc: 东方棍快打 Quick tonfa strike.
优先级极高的抓取，将敌人抛上空中 High-priority grab that tosses the enemy into the air.
过肩背摔落地冲击波，破霸体且无法受身 Over-the-shoulder slam with a shockwave; breaks super armor.
Lv20 接住来招扛肩摔到身后；未触发则直接抓取 Lv20 catches an incoming melee attack and slams the attacker behind you.
抓住敌人向前远远甩出 Grabs and flings the enemy far ahead.
双手各抓一人摔倒（双手飞） Grabs up to two enemies at once and throws them down.
跃起剪刀腿绞住敌人摔倒，可抓空中目标 Leaping leg-scissor that drags even airborne foes down.
大招：抓住敌人旋转，甩飞周围的人后全力抛出 Ultimate: spins the grabbed foe like a hammer, bowling others away, then hurls it.
反手回棍 Backhand tonfa return.
扫腿绊倒 Sweeping kick that trips the foe.

passives.desc: 完成投技回复30法力并获得0.6秒霸体；投技无视霸体且不可受身 Each completed throw refunds 30 MP and grants 0.6 s super armor; throws ignore super armor and deny quick recovery.

classes.famous: 唐昊 Tang Hao / 唐三打 Demon Subduer; 包荣兴 Bao Rongxing / 包子入侵 Steamed Bun Invasion

skills.desc: 利爪横扫 Raking claw swipe.
Lv1 上勾拳挑空 Lv1 rising uppercut that launches.
Lv15 锁喉控住1.4秒，之后敌人防御降低40%、减速 Lv15 neck hold; afterwards the victim's defense drops 40% and it is slowed.
Lv20 板砖拍头造成眩晕，背后拍更久 Lv20 brick to the head: dizzy, longer from behind.
Lv20 扬沙致盲（4秒） Lv20 throws sand in the face: blinds for 4 s.
扔出燃烧瓶，爆炸并点燃范围内敌人 Thrown fire bottle that bursts and sets foes ablaze.
按住敌人连续猛揍后击倒 Pins the enemy and pummels it before knocking it down.
Lv75 大招：以对方最后打中你的技能还击（威力+30%）；未记录时疯狂爪击 Lv75 copies the last skill that hit you and throws it back 30% stronger; otherwise a savage claw flurry.
反手抓挠 Backhand claw rake.
膝撞收尾 Knee strike finisher.

passives.desc: 爪击附带中毒（4秒） Claw strikes poison the target for 4 s.
记住最后一个打中你的敌方技能，大招可原样奉还 Remembers the last enemy skill that hit you; the ultimate returns it.

双剑交错两连斩 Crossing double slash.
突刺收招 Thrusting finisher.

passives.desc: 空中可再跳一次 Jump once more while airborne (double jump).
从背后攻击额外造成 20% 伤害 +20% damage on attacks from behind.
对被标记要害的敌人额外造成 15% 伤害 +15% damage to targets whose vital point you marked.

匕首突刺 Dagger thrust.

passives.desc: 潜行中可布置陷阱，陷阱触发不会使盗贼现形 Traps can be set while stealthed and never reveal the Thief.
